checks.detail: 10/10 categories define lookup controls and hard operations
10/10 categories have pilot items with evidence contracts

rows.lookup_control: Retrieve one page or one sentence containing a relevant entity fact.
rows.hard_grounding_operation: Compose two or more required hops and reject a topically relevant but nonessential page.
rows.failure_if_lookup_only: The answer may be correct but the cited evidence misses one required hop or includes a distractor as if it were necessary.
difficulty_mechanisms: requires evidence composition across separate facts
distractors can support one hop without supporting the final answer
rows.hypothesis: Models will retrieve individually relevant hops but lose answer correctness or conclusion support when the final answer requires evidence composition.

rows.lookup_control: Find a document that contains the requested claim text.
rows.hard_grounding_operation: Select the controlling current snapshot and mark stale evidence as non-controlling.
rows.failure_if_lookup_only: The answer blends old and current snapshots or treats stale evidence as equally valid.
difficulty_mechanisms: requires rejecting plausible stale evidence
requires selecting the controlling current document snapshot
rows.hypothesis: Models will overuse plausible stale evidence unless the scoring source forces recency-conditioned citation and answer selection.

rows.lookup_control: Find the original paper body passage that states a relevant claim.
rows.hard_grounding_operation: Detect appended or lifecycle material that narrows, qualifies, or supersedes the original body.
rows.failure_if_lookup_only: The answer cites original-body evidence for a conclusion controlled by the appended material.
difficulty_mechanisms: requires tracking document state after appendices or errata
requires recognizing when later appended material supersedes body text
rows.hypothesis: Models will treat appended or corrective text as additive context instead of a document-state transition that can supersede earlier content.

rows.lookup_control: Extract a table cell or caption fact.
rows.hard_grounding_operation: Combine table denotation with surrounding text before drawing the conclusion.
rows.failure_if_lookup_only: The answer extracts the right cell but draws a conclusion the text or caption does not support.
difficulty_mechanisms: requires joining structured table cells with textual qualifiers
requires numeric or tabular grounding plus prose interpretation
rows.hypothesis: Models will cite the correct table cell while failing the prose qualifier or interpretation required to make the answer grounded.

rows.lookup_control: Find a clear source that says a plausible answer.
rows.hard_grounding_operation: Rank sources by authority and explain why lower-authority evidence is rejected.
rows.failure_if_lookup_only: The answer chooses the clearest prose instead of the highest-authority source.
difficulty_mechanisms: requires resolving evidence by authority hierarchy
requires ignoring lower-authority evidence that is locally plausible
rows.hypothesis: Models will synthesize lower- and higher-authority sources unless the task requires an explicit authority hierarchy.

rows.lookup_control: Find a related fact or candidate evidence passage.
rows.hard_grounding_operation: Decide whether the evidence entails the requested conclusion and abstain when it does not.
rows.failure_if_lookup_only: The answer supplies a plausible conclusion from evidence that supports only a related premise.
difficulty_mechanisms: requires distinguishing relevant context from sufficient evidence
requires abstaining when citations are near misses
rows.hypothesis: Models will answer from near-miss evidence instead of abstaining when relevance is present but sufficiency is absent.

rows.category: citation supports fact but not conclusion
rows.lookup_control: Find a citation that supports a true premise.
rows.hard_grounding_operation: Separate premise support from conclusion support and reject unsupported inference.
rows.failure_if_lookup_only: The answer uses a true citation as post-hoc support for a broader conclusion it does not entail.
difficulty_mechanisms: requires checking whether cited facts license the final conclusion
requires detecting conclusion overreach despite faithful subfact citation
rows.hypothesis: Models will cite true premises and still make unsupported comparative, causal, or interpretive conclusions.

rows.lookup_control: Find a fact about a name, title, place, or abbreviation.
rows.hard_grounding_operation: Resolve the intended entity and reject same-name or same-title distractors.
rows.failure_if_lookup_only: The answer merges entities that share a surface form.
difficulty_mechanisms: requires binding evidence to the intended referent
requires resisting same-name or near-name distractors
rows.hypothesis: Models will retrieve or cite same-name evidence while answering about the wrong referent.

rows.category: temporal questions: as of date X
rows.lookup_control: Find the most salient or newest relevant evidence.
rows.hard_grounding_operation: Filter evidence by the requested as-of date and exclude future or stale evidence.
rows.failure_if_lookup_only: The answer leaks later evidence into an as-of answer or ignores the date constraint.
difficulty_mechanisms: requires answering relative to an explicit date
requires excluding evidence outside the requested temporal snapshot
rows.hypothesis: Models will answer using globally current or generally true evidence rather than the requested as-of date.

rows.lookup_control: Find documents that mention the topic.
rows.hard_grounding_operation: Partition incompatible evidence and report conflict or apply the stated control rule.
rows.failure_if_lookup_only: The answer smooths contradictory evidence into a false consensus.
difficulty_mechanisms: requires reporting conflict or applying a control rule
requires avoiding synthesis across incompatible documents
rows.hypothesis: Models will merge incompatible documents into a single unsupported answer instead of reporting conflict or applying a control rule.
